title: QUADRUPLE BERRY – IGET BAR – 3500 PUFFS

IGET BAR QUADRUPLE BERRY – 3500 PUFFS Disposable Vape

IGET BAR Disposable vape is designed as a disposable device for leisure vaping, made of light SS material & providing a comfortable hand feeling.

Each device contains a battery of 950mAh to keep the device running up to 3500 puffs.

IGET BAR Features:
